# frontend internals (ui/) — LLM doc index

> The Krateo Composable Portal: a React 19 + Vite single-page app whose entire UI is
> **server-driven**. The SPA renders no hardcoded pages — it fetches `Widget` custom resources
> (resolved to JSON by snowplow) and maps each `kind` to a React component via an auto-discovered
> widget registry. The shell Layout, sidebar Menu and all routes come from CRs at runtime. This
> index is the agent entry point to the **internals & runtime** view. The **deployment, chart and
> CRD wiring** view is the root bundle: ../../docs/llms.txt (same repo — app and charts ship
> together from one tag since the monorepo fold).

## How to use this index (agents)

You are reading the docs for a SPECIFIC deployed version. Fetch every file below at the git tag
that matches the running build: the frontend Deployment's image tag == the repo tag == the chart
appVersion (one version line; plain semver, no v prefix). If something isn't in the docs, read the
source at that same tag — don't guess, and don't trust `main` for a deployed older version. Claims
in these docs are traced to `file:line` (paths relative to ui/); if a doc and the code disagree,
the code wins.

## Start here (internals & runtime)

docs/architecture.md: how the SPA is built — entry point, provider stack, the auto-discovered widget registry, WidgetRenderer, useWidgetQuery, the Shell layout route and routes-as-data. Read first.
docs/behavior.md: runtime behavior — config.json contract, upstream contracts (authn/snowplow/events/autopilot), auth + token handling, bootstrap, pagination, actions, events + live refresh.
docs/gotchas.md: real runtime pitfalls grounded in the code/config.

## Widget-author & contributor reference

docs/widget-authoring.md: how an antd component becomes a widget; the schema.json → types/CRD pipeline; scaffolding; auto-registration; antd-fidelity rules.
docs/widgets-api-reference.md: generated per-widget API reference (npm run update-readme-widgets).
docs/docs.md: the widget concept — widgetData, widgetDataTemplate, actions, resourcesRefs(Template).
docs/form-values.md: Form initialValues semantics (precedence, drafts, re-seed).
docs/restactions.md: pointer — RESTActions are snowplow's; how widgets consume them.
docs/cr-migration-map.json: the hard-break CR migration map (legacy kinds/props → current).
docs/guides/simple-page/simple-page.md: worked guide — Button + convention Flex page + sidebar Menu item.
docs/guides/action-button/action-button.md: worked guide — openDrawer action, then a Form rest action.

## Records (dated; re-verify against code before relying on them)

docs/antd-migration-plan.md: the executed antd-fidelity migration decision record (status: diverged — see its implemented-reality note).
docs/autocomplete-and-dependencies.md: removed-feature note (Form autocomplete/dependencies no longer exist).
docs/evidence-org-guess.md: known gap — the Autopilot Evidence panel guesses a repo link's GitHub org from the repository name, and the two-line repo-mcp-server change that would remove the guess.

## Source of truth

src/widgets/<Kind>/ — each widget: <Kind>.schema.json (the CRD source of truth), <Kind>.tsx (the component), index.ts (the defineWidget registration). NB folder List registers kind Listy.
src/types/Widget.d.ts — the Widget / ResourceRef / actions shapes the SPA consumes.
src/context/ConfigContext.tsx — the typed runtime config contract (config.json), key by key.
public/config/config.json — DEV sample only; the deployed config comes from the chart (stale keys — see docs/gotchas.md).
